One of the worst experiences I've ever had. The service was extremely slow, unprofessional, and completely lacking in customer care. The staff seemed uninterested in helping customers and did not maintain a professional attitude. The food quality was disappointing, and the hospitality was far below acceptable standards.

The management appeared poorly organized, which was reflected in the overall service experience. From start to finish, there was little attention to customer satisfaction. Overall, it was a very unsatisfactory visit that requires serious improvement in service, staff training, and management practices.

Based on my experience, I would not recommend this restaurant to others.

owner_response.text: Thank you for sharing your feedback. We are truly sorry for your experience, we will work on the issues we are currently hiring new staff. Thank you for bringing this to our attention.
